items.source: Configure the CacheStatisticsCollector to use.

items.translation: 启用缓存锁定以在多个缓存实例之间同步缓存访问。

items.source: Use immediate writes (i.e. write operations such as RedisCacheWriter.put(String, byte[], byte[], Duration) or RedisCacheWriter.clear(String, byte[])) shall apply immediately.
items.translation: 使用即时写入（即写操作，例如RedisCacheWriter.put(String, byte[], byte[], Duration)或RedisCacheWriter.clear(String, byte[])）必须立即生效。

items.source: Configure whether to use immediate writes (i.e. write operations such as RedisCacheWriter.put(String, byte[], byte[], Duration) or RedisCacheWriter.clear(String, byte[])) shall apply immediately.
items.translation: 配置是否使用即时写入（即写入操作，如RedisCacheWriter.put(String, byte[], byte[], Duration)或RedisCacheWriter.clear(String, byte[])）是否立即生效。

items.source: Create new RedisCacheWriter configure it through RedisCacheWriter.RedisCacheWriterConfigurer.
items.translation: 创建新的RedisCacheWriter，并通过RedisCacheWriter.RedisCacheWriterConfigurer进行配置。

items.source: Configure the BatchStrategy when clearing the cache (i.e. bulk removal of cache keys).
items.translation: 在清除缓存（即批量删除缓存键）时，配置BatchStrategy。

items.source: Package providing a Redis implementation for Spring cache abstraction.
items.translation: 提供用于 Spring 的 Redis 实现的包 缓存抽象。

items.translation: 配置缓存锁定以在多个缓存实例之间同步缓存访问。
